prs.title: chore: waive RUSTSEC-2026-0543 (chrono unmaintained)
prs.body:
## Why

The Dependency Audit job is failing on `main` (runs for #751 and #752) and will fail on every open pull request. Nothing merged caused it: RUSTSEC-2026-0543 was published today and marks `chrono` unmaintained, all versions affected, no safe upgrade.

```
error[unmaintained]: chrono is unmaintained
  chrono 0.4.45
  ID: RUSTSEC-2026-0543
advisories FAILED, bans ok, licenses ok, sources ok
```

## What

- `deny.toml`: waive RUSTSEC-2026-0543, with the rationale.
- `.cargo/audit.toml`: the same id, since that list must stay a superset of `deny.toml`'s.

## What this does not do

`chrono` is a direct workspace dependency of `offline-protocol`, `offline-protocol-mls`, `offline-protocol-reliability` and `offline-protocol-router`, compiled and shipped. The waiver is a notice-not-vulnerability call that buys time; the remedy is a migration to `jiff` or `time`, which touches persisted and serialized timestamps and belongs in its own pull request. The waiver comment says to drop it there.

## Verification

- `cargo deny --all-features check`: `advisories ok, bans ok, licenses ok, sources ok` (the same command CI runs).
- `cargo audit`: reported RUSTSEC-2026-0543 before the change, does not after.
